lines: +# Harbor upgrade notes
+Migration only, on upstream Harbor in `/opt/venvs/rollout-next` (venv untouched, `recipe.env` untouched):
+- New `rollout/harbor_compat.py`, wired in by `harbor_agent_function.build_trial_config` via
+  `AgentConfig.import_path=harbor_compat:MilesTerminus2` and
+  `VerifierConfig.import_path=harbor_compat:LegacyRewardVerifier`, plus `install_trial_compat()` in `run()`.
+  It restores the deleted branch's row-visible semantics upstream dropped: abort (never salvage/re-send)
+  a reply truncated at `max_tokens`; abort a turn whose prompt+response exceeds `max_seq_len` before its
+  commands run, with the verifier still grading afterwards (`MaxSeqLenExceededError` /
+  `SingleTurnMaxSeqLenExceededError` -> `SequenceLengthLimitExceeded`); old reward-file parsing (below);
+  task-dir `trajectory.json` seeds are ignored (upstream would seed from them, or fail the trial on the
+  one non-ATIF file), and `solution/` symlinks escaping the task dir (incl. two dangling ones) no longer
+  fail task loading. `rollout/env.sh` now defaults to `rollout-next`; `rollout/tests/test_harbor_compat.py`
+  pins the restored behaviours.
+- Verified: replay of `data/recorded/batch_1003.jsonl` is 57/57 identical to `data/rows/` (tokens, loss
+  mask, logprobs, reward, dropped set); 64 unit/contract/compat tests pass; solved-policy probes cover
+  opsbench/gradekit/sftseed/sharedsol (all 131 `/data/tasks`), salvageable-truncation and cumulative
+  8192-token aborts, a sandbox-kill (`BackendFailure` -> InfraError/aborted), and separate-verifier
+  solves+non-solves on `/data/tasks_next`.
+- Live proof (final code, real engine at 127.0.0.1:30000): `rollout/proof/live_next.rows.jsonl`
+  (+ `.meta.json`), 8 `sepv-*` tasks (2 each config/count/csv/py) x 4 samples, seeds 71001-71032.
+  All 32 reward 0: the 0.6B live policy solved none; scripted separate-verifier probes above score 1,
+  so that is the policy, not the verifier path.
+Preserved as-is, looks wrong, fix separately:
+- `gradekit-lines-b1d595` (txt) and `-bff77a` (`"reward": recall`): expected-empty tasks emit NaN rewards,
+  so every episode aborts as InfraError. NaN in a side key only (`-f58407` etc.) does not abort.
+- `tmax-csv-a1aa69`: the failing branch writes `inf` as the reward, so unsolved episodes abort instead of
+  training as negatives (solved episodes write 1 normally).
+- `tmax-count-9f3a01`: writes `PASS`/`FAIL` to reward.txt, unparseable as a float, so every episode
+  (solved or not) trains at reward 0.
+- `opsbench-count-93c16c`: `{"reward": "1", "detail": "graded by opsbench v2"}` fails reward coercion on
+  the non-numeric `detail`, so even solved episodes train at reward 0. Other opsbench string numbers coerce.
+- A sandbox lost during the verifier's test upload/download surfaces as
+  `AddTestsDirError`/`DownloadVerifierDirError`, not a broker exception type, so it trains as
+  AgentError/reward 0 instead of aborting as InfraError (the mapping keys on exception type only).
